name: Chameleon
description: Chameleon is a product-adoption platform for Tours, Tooltips, Embeddables, Microsurveys, Launchers, HelpBar, and interactive Demos. Product teams use it to build targeted in-product guidance and measure engagement.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact Chameleon account with a customer-owned account secret, then let agents list only bounded, strictly projected Tour inventory metadata under approval. Relay excludes segments, tags, dashboard URLs, content/audience summaries, stats, profiles, companies, interactions, responses, publishing, deliveries, imports, and raw API access.

credentialRequirements.name: CHAMELEON_ACCOUNT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Chameleon account secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a dedicated account-specific secret and store the one-time value only through Relay's encrypted connection flow.

capabilities.label: List Tours
capabilities.description: List at most 50 Tour IDs, names, delivery styles, and lifecycle timestamps without content, targeting, stats, or user data.

approvalRequired.label: List Tours
approvalRequired.description: List bounded projected Tour inventory metadata from one exact Chameleon account.

blocked.label: Access private Tour data
blocked.description: Segments, tags, dashboard URLs, content/audience summaries, steps, targeting, translations, and stats are blocked.

blocked.label: Access profiles, companies, or interactions
blocked.description: User profiles, companies, attributes, interactions, responses, identities, and event-level data are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate or administer Chameleon
blocked.description: Publishing, Tour changes, deliveries, imports, webhooks, tags, domains, rate/alert groups, and administration are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw or bulk access
blocked.description: Raw paths, query secrets, pagination, polling, retries, batches, CSV, downloads, and provider-response pass-through are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded Tour inventory requires approval; private content, profiles, interactions, writes, bulk data, and raw APIs remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded Tour inventory runs without Relay per-action approval; exact account/fixed-origin binding, strict projection, response cap, audits, and no-write behavior remain enforced.

providerSetup.blocker: An authorized Chameleon administrator must generate a dedicated account-specific secret, capture its one-time value, and store it through Relay. No account, token creation, credential capture, live API request, or provider acceptance is available in this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized Chameleon administrator generates a dedicated account secret, stores it through Relay, then verifies health, one approved Tour list, throttling, token rotation/revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Chameleon documents GET /v3/edit/tours, a default list limit of 50 and maximum of 500, cursor pagination, and Tour fields including IDs, names, styles, timestamps, segments, tags, dashboard URLs, content/audience summaries, and stats. Relay requests at most 50 and projects only low-sensitivity inventory fields.

Chameleon documents the fixed https://api.chameleon.io origin, v3 environment-prefixed routes, and account-specific one-time secrets sent in X-Account-Secret. Relay encrypts the secret and never places it in query parameters.

Chameleon documents profiles, companies, segments, Tours, interactions, survey responses, deliveries, imports, webhooks, and mutation endpoints. Relay selects one Tour list and blocks all other resources and writes.
